# Ballast: Quit PMO Addiction

> Your plan for the next urge. Private. Secular. No brain myths. Official website by Mohamed Elatabany.

Ballast is an on-device iPhone app (iOS 26 or later) for adults who want to quit porn and compulsive masturbation (PMO). It has a four-step panic button for urges, if-then plans, a streak clock, ten levels that a slip never takes away, and a one-tap iOS adult-website filter. The full urge flow, slip support and the filter are free. There is no account and no server. Personal entries stay on device; Apple and RevenueCat process purchases. It uses skills from CBT and ACT. It is not treatment.

App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6803731313
Facts checked: 25 November 2026

## Plain product summary

What it is: an iPhone app that helps adults quit porn and compulsive masturbation (PMO). Made by one independent developer, Mohamed Elatabany. Requires iOS 26 or later. iPhone only. The App Store name is "Ballast: Quit PMO Addiction", App Store ID 6803731313. This describes version 1.4.0, released 13 November 2026, a full redesign. It has five tabs: Home, Progress, Panic, Toolkit and Blocker.

- Home. A light in the colours of the person's level, a streak clock that counts to the second, a goal of 7 to 365 days in a row with the date it lands on, four quick actions (Check in, Breathe, Journal, Reset), today's two minutes, the filter's state, and a button, "I'm having an urge".
- Panic. Four steps: breathe with a light (in for four, out for six) beside one of the person's own reasons; do their own if-then plan, or pick one of three small things; ride it out on a ten-minute timer, with sound, exercises or someone to text; then say how it went, "It passed" or "I slipped". It opens from Home, the Panic tab, Control Centre or Siri, and works with no plan saved and no connection. The timer also runs on the Lock Screen as a Live Activity. The whole flow is free.
- Progress. Total days free, which never reset, and the level they set. Ten levels: Spark (0 days free), Ember (1), Flame (3), Torch (7), Lantern (14), Beacon (30), Star (60), Sun (100), Nova (180), Polaris (365). Best streak, urges beaten, a calendar, and an estimate of hours back worked out from the person's own answers. A slip restarts the streak. It never takes a level away.
- After a slip. A slip logged for today restarts the streak; the level, total days free and best streak stay. A slip logged for an earlier day takes that one day off the total, and the app says so before saving. Then one small thing for the next hour. No price is ever shown there.
- Toolkit. Today's lesson from a 30-day course that uses skills from CBT and ACT, and six tools: Breathe, Sounds, My plans (if-then cards), Journal, Reading and Habits. Under More: quick exercises, the weekly review, Cut the easy access (seven one-time changes), a check-in card for a trusted person, and where to get help.
- Blocker. One tap turns on the iOS adult-website filter through Apple's Family Controls (free). iOS asks for Screen Time access the first time. There is no VPN. The filter also turns off Safari private browsing. Apple's filter can miss sites, so people can add their own: 3 free, up to 25 with Pro, kept on the phone and handed to iOS. Pro adds a commitment lock (a wait chosen in advance of 10 minutes, 1 hour or 24 hours, or a code held by a trusted person, with a 24-hour wait always available) and blocked apps until a chosen time. A phone's owner can undo all of this in Settings. If Pro ends, locks and blocked apps let go and the filter stays under the person's control.
- Widgets show the streak, level and goal on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.

Free: the whole urge flow, slip logging and after-slip support; streak, total days free, levels and goal; check-ins and today's two minutes; the heads-up before the hardest window; the website filter and 3 sites of your own; one if-then plan and one habit; course week one and all reading about urges and slips; breathing, sounds, exercises, Cut the easy access, getting help and the partner card; this month's calendar and a week of journal; app lock, export, backup and restore.

Pro: the commitment lock; blocked apps; up to 25 sites of your own; unlimited if-then plans; Insights and the weekly review; course weeks 2 to 4 and the rest of the library; every month and the whole journal; unlimited habits. Sold as monthly, yearly or lifetime. Prices are shown in the App Store.

Privacy: no account and no server. Personal entries stay on the device, though Apple's iCloud or computer backups of the phone can include app data. Ballast asks RevenueCat whether the user has Pro each time the app is opened or comes back to the front. No browsing or app data leaves the phone; Apple's picker hides app choices from Ballast. Apple and RevenueCat process purchases. No analytics or advertising SDKs.

Limits: it is not treatment and does not diagnose. It has no community or groups. It cannot stop a determined device owner. Apple does not say which other browsers its filter covers, and it filters websites, not what is inside other apps. There is no outcome data for the app. It makes no claims about dopamine, rewiring or fixed timelines; it uses skills from CBT and ACT, and research on those is promising with a high risk of bias.

Who it may not suit: people who want a community, a faith-based program, reports sent to another person, or Android.

Updated 2026-11-25.
- [What to do after a slip](https://quitpmo.com/what-to-do-after-a-slip.html): A matter-of-fact plan for the next ten minutes, the next hour and tomorrow morning: get out of the situation, record what happened, adjust the plan, and when to ask for more help. Updated 2026-11-25.
- [Apps to quit porn or PMO, compared](https://quitpmo.com/best-apps-to-quit-porn-compared.html): A dated comparison of ten App Store apps by US ratings, pricing structure and review themes, with the author's conflict of interest at the top and a section on where competitors are better than Ballast. Updated 2026-11-25.
- [QUITTR left the App Store: what's known and what to do](https://quitpmo.com/quittr-left-the-app-store.html): A dated account of what can be verified about QUITTR's missing listing, with the cause stated as unknown, plus how to cancel a subscription through Apple, keep your start date and choose what's next. Updated 2026-11-25.
